description: Revoke an API key, immediately blocking all requests using that key. This cannot be undone. A test key can revoke any of the account's keys except a live one: revoking a live key needs a live key (403 LIVE_KEY_REQUIRED).

account_id.description: Your account ID. Omit it and it is resolved from your API key.

key_id.description: The API key record ID to revoke (from get_account api_keys list).

name: revoke_api_key
title: Revoke API key
